verdicts.reason: A: the headline is far too small for a 614×768 canvas and sits flush left while the logo, can and CTA run down the centre, so it has two competing axes. There is also a large gap between headline and subhead, the SOLSTICE wordmark is too small to read, and the bottom fifth is empty. B: the can is bigger and reads first, but the headline and subhead (left edge ~31px) don't line up with the CTA or the logo (~105–110px). The headline is also undersized and the subhead floats far from it, so the text block looks ragged.

A keeps the original layout (product left, copy and CTA right), so it is faithful and well grouped. But it is basically a shrunk landscape banner: everything sits in a thin middle band with empty space above and below it, and the copy is tiny. The CTA's left edge (~403px) also doesn't line up with the headline and subhead (~340px). B restacks the layout for the taller shape but has mixed axes (headline left, the rest centred), a small headline, a large headline-to-subhead gap, the CTA far from its copy, and a logo too small to read.

A is a tidier version of B: the headline and subhead sit closer together, the can is larger and carries the centre, and the CTA anchors the bottom. It is still flawed: the headline is undersized and inset at 69px, which lines up with nothing, and the SOLSTICE logo is illegibly small. B has the same structure but a smaller can, a loose gap between headline and subhead, copy jammed toward the left edge, and a dead bottom area.
